q: كيف أقرأ ملفاً نصياً في بايثون؟
re: ما طريقة قراءة محتوى ملف نصي؟
answer:
استخدم open مع with ليُغلق الملف تلقائياً:
with open("file.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    text = f.read()
ولقراءة سطراً سطراً: f.readlines() أو التكرار على f.

en.q: How do I read a text file in Python?
en.re: What is the way to read a file's contents?
en.v: I want to open and read a text file
en.answer:
Use open with with so the file closes automatically:
with open("file.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    text = f.read()
For line-by-line reading: f.readlines() or loop over f.

q: كيف أكتب نصاً في ملف ببايثون؟
re: ما طريقة حفظ نص داخل ملف جديد؟
answer:
استخدم وضع الكتابة "w" (و"a" للإضافة في النهاية):
with open("file.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("النص المطلوب")

en.q: How do I write text to a file in Python?
en.re: How can I save text into a new file?
en.v: I want to write a string to a file
en.answer:
Use write mode "w" (or "a" to append):
with open("file.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("Hello there")

q: كيف أضيف نصاً إلى نهاية ملف موجود؟
re: ما طريقة الإلحاق في ملف بدل الكتابة فوقه؟
v: أريد أزيد سطر في نهاية الملف
answer:
استخدم وضع الإلحاق "a":
with open("file.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("سطر جديد\n")

en.q: How do I append text to an existing file?
en.re: How do I add to a file without overwriting it?
en.v: I want to add a line at the end of a file
en.answer:
Use append mode "a":
with open("file.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("a new line\n")

answer:

en.v: I want to sort by the price field

sorted_products = sorted(products, key=lambda p: p["price"])

حدّث الفهارس ثم ثبّت:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install اسم_الحزمة

en.q: How do I install a package on Ubuntu?
en.re: How does apt install work?
en.v: I want to install software from the terminal
en.answer:
Update indexes then install:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install package_name

q: كيف أحفظ ناتج أمر في ملف؟
answer:
استخدم إعادة التوجيه:
command > file.txt  # كتابة فوقية
command >> file.txt  # إلحاق

en.q: How do I save a command's output to a file?
en.re: How do > and >> redirection work?
en.v: I want the command output inside a file
en.answer:
Use redirection:
command > file.txt  # overwrite
command >> file.txt  # append

q: كيف أمرر ناتج أمر إلى آخر؟
answer:
استخدم الأنبوب |:
ps aux | grep python | wc -l
ناتج كل أمر يدخل التالي.

en.q: How do I pass one command's output to another?
en.re: What does the pipe | mean in the terminal?
en.v: I want to chain two commands
en.answer:
Use the pipe |:
ps aux | grep python | wc -l
Each command feeds the next.

answer:
استخدم diff:
diff file1.txt file2.txt
أوضحاً: diff -u file1 file2

en.q: How do I compare two files line by line?
en.re: How does the diff command work?
en.v: I want to see the difference between two files
en.answer:
Use diff:
diff file1.txt file2.txt
Nicer: diff -u file1 file2

answer:

git status

en.q: How do I see the state of my git repository?
en.re: What does git status show?
en.v: I want to see what changed in my repo
en.answer:
Use:
git status
Shows modified, staged, and untracked files.

answer:

en.q: How do I view the commit history?

Use:

With the changes: git log -p

q: كيف أنشئ فرعاً جديداً وأنتقل إليه؟

أنشئ وانتقل:
git branch feature-x
git switch feature-x

en.q: How do I create a new branch and switch to it?
en.re: How do git branch and switch work?
en.v: I want a new branch for my feature
en.answer:
Create then switch:
git branch feature-x
git switch feature-x
Or directly: git switch -c feature-x

answer:

git switch main
git merge feature-x
للدمج بأعلى التاريخ: git rebase main

en.q: How do I merge a branch into main?
en.re: How does git merge work?
en.v: I want to combine my branches
en.answer:
Switch to the target then merge:
git switch main
git merge feature-x
Top-of-history merge: git rebase main

q: كيف أخفي تعديلاتي مؤقتاً دون التزام؟

answer:
استخدم stash:
git stash
للإرجاع: git stash pop
للسرد: git stash list

en.q: How do I hide my changes temporarily without committing?
en.re: How does git stash work?
en.v: I want to set my changes aside and work on something else
en.answer:
Use stash:
git stash
Restore: git stash pop
List: git stash list

q: كيف ألغي آخر التزام مع الاحتفاظ بالتغييرات؟

answer:
استخدم reset الناعم:
git reset --soft HEAD~1
التغييرات تعود إلى منطقة الإعداد.

en.q: How do I undo the last commit but keep the changes?
en.re: How does git reset --soft work?
en.v: I want my last commit back with files kept
en.answer:
Use a soft reset:
git reset --soft HEAD~1
The changes return to the staging area.

q: كيف أضيف ملفاً إلى آخر التزام؟

أضف الملف ثم عدّل:

en.q: How do I add a file to the last commit?
en.re: How does commit --amend work?
en.v: I want to fix my last commit
en.answer:
Stage the file then amend:
git add file
git commit --amend --no-edit

git push origin v1.0.0

Create .gitignore with patterns:
node_modules/
*.log
.env
Untrack a tracked file: git rm --cached file

q: كيف أشغّل اختبارات بايثون بـ pytest؟

en.q: How do I run Python tests with pytest?

pip install pytest

Test files start with test_ and functions with test_.

q: كيف أكتب اختباراً بسيطاً بـ pytest؟

def test_add():
    assert add(2, 3) == 5
وقارن باستخدام assert فقط.

en.q: How do I write a simple pytest test?
en.re: What does a test function look like?

en.answer:
Create test_calc.py:
def test_add():
    assert add(2, 3) == 5
Just compare with assert.

en.q: What is the best way to debug with printing?
en.re: Is print enough for debugging?

Better for logs: logging.debug - level-controlled and off in production.

answer:
ضع في المكان المطلوب:
breakpoint()
أو من بايثون 3.7+ يشغّل pdb؛ اخرج بـ q.

en.q: How do I pause execution and inspect variables?
en.re: How does breakpoint work?
en.v: I want to stop the code and look around
en.answer:
Place where you want to pause:
breakpoint()
Python 3.7+ starts pdb; quit with q.

re: ما معنى الأسطر الأخيرة من الخطأ؟
answer:
في بايثون يظهر الخطأ كـ Traceback — اقرأ من الأسفل: نوع الاستثناء والرسالة ثم آخر ملف من كودك.
ValueError: قيمة غير صالحة → اقرأ السطر المذكور فوقه.

en.q: How do I read a Traceback quickly?
en.re: What do the last lines of an error mean?
en.v: I get lost in long errors
en.answer:
In Python the error shows as a Traceback - read from the BOTTOM: the exception type and message, then the last file of your own code.
ValueError: invalid value → read the line above it.
